column3: This demonstration retrieves documents before writing an answer. These records were written for this project as synthetic examples.
Keyword retrieval matches terms in documents. This demonstration uses BM25 for keyword retrieval.
Vector retrieval compares embeddings of queries and documents. A local Ollama service produces the embeddings in this demonstration.
Hybrid retrieval combines keyword and vector rankings. A reranker then selects documents relevant to the current question.
Complex questions are split into steps. Candidate documents are reranked for each subquestion before summaries and cited answers are generated.
Use a fresh index directory after changing the document corpus. Demo records check installation and do not measure retrieval quality.
